bridge.when: About eight centuries after Yunus (shortly before the Common Era)
bridge.where: Jerusalem and the temple, then Bethlehem
text: Centuries pass. The temple in Jerusalem stands again, served by the prophet Zakariya, known as Zechariah.

This chapter tells of a family the Quran honours: the family of Imran. His daughter Maryam, known as Mary, is the only woman the Quran names, and a whole chapter of it bears her name. Her son Isa, known as Jesus, is born by a miracle.
